title: Integrated Extraction for Cells
author: Juan Sanchez
materials: Cells should arrive pelleted and frozen from collaborator
Analyze the samples via UHPLC–Orbitrap as follows.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑mouth pipette, wash the cell pellet with 500 µL of 150 mM ammonium acetate, performing 25 aspirate/dispense cycles.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant (first wash)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 200 g for 5 min, then carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Perform a second centrifugation at 200 g for 5 min and remove the supernatant again.

steps.title: Add stainless‑steel beads
steps.instruction: Add 4–6 non‑sterile 2.3 mm stainless‑steel beads to the tube.

steps.title: Add cold methanol with SPLASH iSTD
steps.instruction: Dispense 225 µL of ice‑cold methanol (kept at –20 °C) containing 1.5 % iSTD “SPLASH” mix into the extraction tube.

steps.title: Bead‑beat homogenization
steps.instruction: Seal the tube and place it in a bead beater set to 20 Hz amplitude for 15 min to homogenize and extract metabolites; then close the tube.

steps.title: Vortex methanol phase
steps.instruction: Vortex the extraction tube for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add MTBE
steps.instruction: Open the tube and add 750 µL of ice‑cold methyl‑tert‑butyl ether (MTBE).

steps.title: Mix MTBE phase
steps.instruction: Close the tube and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Shake at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Shake the tube for 6 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add water with HILIC iSTDs
steps.instruction: Open the tube and add 188 µL of LC‑MS grade water containing the 18 HILIC internal standards at one‑third of their normal concentration (as defined in the HILIC extraction SOP, except CUDA).

steps.title: Mix water phase
steps.instruction: Close the tube and vortex for 20 seconds.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the extraction tube for 2 min at 14,000 × g.

steps.title: Separate upper lipid phase
steps.instruction: Open the tube and transfer 700 µL of the upper (organic) phase into a single 700 µL tube, then split equally into two new tubes (350 µL each), designated Lipidomics tube 1 and Lipidomics tube 2.

steps.title: Collect lower aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of the lower (aqueous) phase into a new tube, designated HILIC tube 1.

steps.title: Evaporate solvents to dryness
steps.instruction: Place Lipidomics tube 1 and HILIC tube 1 in a centrivap and evaporate at room temperature until completely dry.

steps.title: Reconstitute lipid extract
steps.instruction: Reconstitute Lipidomics tube 1 with 120 µL of methanol containing CUDA internal standard, then close the tube.

steps.title: HILIC cleanup – add ACN/H2O
steps.instruction: To HILIC tube 1 add 500 µL of a 1:1 (v/v) acetonitrile:water solution, vortex for 20 seconds.

steps.title: HILIC cleanup – centrifuge
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 2 min.

steps.title: Transfer and dry HILIC supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and dry it down (e.g., in a centrivap) until dry.

steps.title: Reconstitute HILIC extract
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dried HILIC residue in 60 µL of ACN:H₂O (4:1 v/v) containing CUDA, then close the tube.

steps.title: Sonicate extracts
steps.instruction: Sonicate both Lipidomics tube 1 and HILIC tube 1 at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge both tubes at 14,000 × g for 2 min.

steps.title: Aliquot lipid extracts
steps.instruction: Open Lipidomics tube 1 and split the extract equally into two amber glass vials with micro‑inserts, labeled lipidomics vial 1 pos and lipidomics vial 1 neg; close the vials.

steps.title: Aliquot HILIC extract
steps.instruction: Open HILIC tube 1 and transfer the extract into an amber glass vial with a micro‑insert, labeled HILIC vial; close the vial.
